items.checked_metadata: Journal version: Philipp A. Höhn, Alexander R. H. Smith, and Maximilian P. E. Lock, “Trinity of relational quantum dynamics,” Physical Review D 104, 066001 (2021), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevD.104.066001. The cited arXiv v3 is arXiv:1912.00033v3, last revised 2021-04-13; v1 was first submitted 2019-11-29.
items.discrepancy: Current @misc year=2019 prints (Höhn, Smith, and Lock 2019), although the full-text version inspected is arXiv v3 (2021) and the peer-reviewed journal record metadata is 2021. Current title matches the arXiv title but not journal title (journal omits initial “The”).
items.proposal: Use the 2021 Physical Review D publication metadata for the BibTeX record, and preserve arXiv:1912.00033v3 with its 2021-04-13 revision date in a note or version-specific URL to identify the text actually inspected. This does not assert that the journal body was checked against v3. Keep the BibTeX key if minimizing tex changes; natbib uses the year field for the printed citation.
